entities.name: Bifunctional sulfate enzyme
observations: 634-aa query is a close homolog of reviewed NodQ/CysN-CysC proteins (58–63% identity; ~96–98% query coverage).
Homolog annotations support ATP sulfurylase and APS kinase activities; exact organism/source is not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: Sulfate adenylation
observations: Sulfate + ATP + H+ → adenosine 5′-phosphosulfate (APS) + diphosphate (PPi); Rhea RHEA:18133, EC 2.7.7.4.

entities.name: APS phosphorylation
observations: APS + ATP → 3′-phosphoadenylyl sulfate (PAPS) + ADP + H+; Rhea RHEA:24152, EC 2.7.1.25.
